recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中混有粒細胞系與紅血球前驅細胞，其間可見數個胞質豐富、灰藍色、核偏心的大型漿細胞，部分有核旁淡染區；漿細胞明顯增加且型態偏大、偏不成熟，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Several large plasma cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm and eccentric round nuclei
Perinuclear hof visible in some plasma cells; chromatin moderately fine
Plasma cells admixed with granulocytic precursors, bands and segmented neutrophils
Erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei present in the center
Photograph slightly out of focus, limiting assessment of nucleoli and inclusions
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Romanowsky stain) shows a cellular field containing granulocytic precursors, segmented neutrophils, and erythroid precursors, together with several increased large plasma cells. The plasma cells have abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, eccentric round nuclei with moderately fine chromatin, and focal perinuclear hofs. The image is slightly out of focus, which limits evaluation of nucleoli and cytoplasmic inclusions. Findings are consistent with involvement by plasma cell myeloma in the context of a reported 60% marrow plasma cells and a monoclonal protein.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small and mature with coarse chromatin, usually below 10% and polytypic by light chain studies.
Osteoblasts also have eccentric nuclei and a pale zone, but are larger, comet-shaped, occur in small sheets, and the pale zone lies away from the nucleus.
LPL shows a continuum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P rather than large immature plasma cells.
